title: Recommendation Effect (v1.0.0)
description: Before/after measurement of a recommendation's impact on headway and EWT. Produced by the data layer (gold view) after the horizon window closes. Screen US-11. See ADR-0003.

schema_version.description: Read contract version (SemVer). Turn 1 produces only 1.0.0.

rec_id.description: UUID v4 of the recommendation this effect measurement belongs to.

headway_before_s.description: Observed headway in seconds at the target stop immediately before the action was applied. Null if not enough data.

headway_after_s.description: Observed headway in seconds at the target stop after the action horizon elapsed. Null if not enough data.

headway_planned_s.description: Planned headway in seconds for this time window. Turn 1 peak value: 600 s.

ewt_expected_s.description: EWT reduction projected by the recommendation engine at proposal time, in seconds. Null if D1 (information-only case).

ewt_observed_s.description: Actual EWT observed at the target stop after the horizon window, in seconds. Null if not enough data.

result.description: Effect assessment. 'worked': EWT improved by at least 30 s (ewt_expected_s - ewt_observed_s >= 30); hypothesis threshold to validate with the dispatcher. 'partial': EWT improved but by less than 30 s (0 < improvement < 30 s), or headway improved but EWT did not. 'did_not_work': neither headway nor EWT improved. 'no_data': insufficient observations after the horizon.
